_comment: Golden frame-encoding vectors — the cross-language conformance contract. Frame = channel:u8 | flags:u8 | length:u32-LE | payload. Every implementation must encode (channel,flags,payloadHex) to EXACTLY frameHex, and decode frameHex back to the same triple. Keep in sync with proto/protocol.md and both test suites (mac/Tests, shared/cpp/tests).
_inputComment: INPUT event record (proto/protocol.md §5), 44 bytes LE: type:u8 tool:u8 buttons:u8 flags:u8 | timestampMs:u64 | x:f32 y:f32 pressure:f32 | tiltX:f32 tiltY:f32 | scrollX:f32 scrollY:f32 | keyCode:u16 pointerId:u16. Asserted by mac InputCodecTests; ArkTS InputCodec.ets must match.

inputVectors._comment: All fields DISTINCT and NONZERO so a cross-language field transposition can't pass silently. timestampMs (1234567890123 = 0x11F71FB04CB) is > 2^32 so the u64 hi half is NONZERO (hi=287, lo=1912276171) — this pins the ArkTS hi/lo split + divisor that the all-zero vector never exercised — yet stays < 2^53 so it survives JSON.parse as an exact JS Number (real epoch-ms are this magnitude).
inputVectors.name: input-all-fields-distinct
